## Definition of done

- [ ] `make check` passes for all affected stacks.
- [ ] New behavior has tests and backend coverage meets its threshold.
- [ ] API changes include regenerated and committed OpenAPI and TypeScript schemas.
- [ ] Model changes include a migration and `alembic check` reports no drift.
- [ ] No secrets are committed; new settings are documented in `.env.example`.
- [ ] Changes are committed with a clear task-prefixed message.
